target.title: fix(agents): deliver the sessions_yield message instead of a silent spawn-and-wait turn
target.body:
Fixes #107788

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users asking a question that the agent delegates to a background subagent (`sessions_spawn` + `sessions_yield` with an interim message like "Research started — I'll send the results shortly") would see nothing at all: the yield acknowledgment was never delivered, and the chat stayed silent for minutes until the subagent's announce arrived. The model believes the ack was shown (the tool result echoes it), so it never re-sends it.

## Why This Change Was Made

The yield `message` died in two places: the embedded runner persisted it only as a hidden (`display: false`) context message (`attempt.sessions-yield.ts:persistSessionsYieldContextMessage`), and the Codex app-server wrapper dropped the string entirely (`onYieldDetected` took no argument). Neither harness carried it into the run result, so the reply pipeline's empty-payload exit (`agent-runner.ts`) returned silence.

Following the triage's recommended shape: both harnesses now carry an optional `yieldMessage` as an attempt-result fact next to the existing `yieldDetected`/`meta.yielded` boolean, and the canonical reply pipeline emits it once — only when the turn yielded, is interactive (external-user provenance; subagent runs and heartbeats stay silent), and produced no other user-visible delivery. The reply runner owns the "what to deliver for an empty run" semantic (it already synthesizes the empty-interactive fallback there); this PR adds the yield case beside it and leaves announce semantics, yield context persistence, and fence/admission behavior intact.

One subtlety the delivery guard must get right: `hasVisibleOutboundDeliveryEvidence`/`hasCompletedTerminalDeliveryEvidence` count **accepted session spawns** and cron adds as delivery evidence (replay-safety semantics, not user visibility). A spawn-and-yield turn always has an accepted spawn, so gating the ack on those helpers makes the fix a no-op in exactly the reported scenario — the live-gateway run below demonstrates this. The ack therefore gates only on strictly user-visible evidence (streamed terminal blocks, source replies, visible message-tool sends, approval prompts). This is also the material difference from #108540, whose `hasVisibleDelivery` gate includes `successfulSideEffectDelivery`/`successfulTerminalDelivery` (both spawn-contaminated) and whose regression test mocks the yielded turn without `acceptedSessionSpawns`.

Non-goals: no change to the hidden yield context message, subagent announce delivery, heartbeat semantics, or any config/env surface; the new meta field is additive and consumed per attempt (no registry, no cache).

## User Impact

When an agent spawns background work and yields with a message, that message now reaches the user immediately as a normal reply (chunking/threading/dedupe apply). Spawn-and-yield turns no longer look like delivery failures.

## Evidence

Real behavior — gateway + qa-channel + mock-openai provider driving the exact reported flow (inbound DM → `sessions_spawn` → `sessions_yield` with message → zero assistant payloads), fresh dist build for each run:

Before (current main, head `6f22ef08a37`): the ack wait times out — silence until the subagent announce.
~~~text
### Yield ack delivery proof
- Status: fail
- Details: timed out after 90000ms
  - [ ] yield ack is delivered to the QA DM
~~~

After (this branch): the yield message is delivered as an outbound DM reply.
~~~text
### Yield ack delivery proof
- Status: pass
  - [x] yield ack is delivered to the QA DM
    - Details: ack="Waiting for QA-SUBAGENT-DIRECT-FALLBACK-OK." outbound=qa-dm-yield-ack:Waiting for QA-SUBAGENT-DIRECT-FALLBACK-OK.
~~~

The pre-existing `subagent-completion-direct-fallback` scenario still passes on this branch (completion delivery unchanged).

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner.misc.runreplyagent.test.ts` — 77 passed, including the new symptom test (yielded spawn turn with `acceptedSessionSpawns` delivers the ack; without a message it stays silent)
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-failure-reply.test.ts` — 9 passed (guard matrix: heartbeat / non-interactive / silent-expected / message-tool-only / already-delivered / empty message)
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/dynamic-tool-build.test.ts` — 50 passed, including the new Codex `onYield` message passthrough test
- Negative control on unpatched tree: the symptom test fails (`expected reply result to be an object` — the turn returns silence) → the regression tests guard this bug
- `CI=1 pnpm check:changed` — all lanes green except the format lane, which aborts on this Windows host with `spawn ENAMETOOLONG` (file-list length, not a formatting error); `oxfmt --check` on all 14 touched files: "All matched files use the correct format." `oxlint` on touched files: clean. `tsgo -p tsconfig.core.json`: no new errors (4 pre-existing environment errors reproduce identically on clean main).

AI-assisted (Claude Code); I have reviewed and understand every line.
target.author: moerai
